purpose: Teach: 中央アジア/外界/アルカイダ/ガザ/公爵/敗者/前世/難問

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、中央アジアのシルクロード史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you worked on the Silk Road history of Central Asia for your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Slight upward lift on the name, inviting. Measured pace. The tone of a teacher who's genuinely curious about a student's work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、新生児と外界刺激の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—actually, I focused on newborn responses to external stimuli.
lines.style: Gentle correction, not defensive. Slightly self-conscious about the clarification. Quieter than Asuka, respectful. The rhythm of someone being honest about their own work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、アルカイダ系組織の資金源を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you covered Al-Qaeda funding sources in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before the statement. Steady, observant tone. Asuka's checking in—noticing something. Not accusatory, just alert.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、ガザ地区の人道援助史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I actually wrote about the history of humanitarian aid in Gaza.
lines.style: Quieter this time. A small hesitation before the correction. Ren holding his ground gently, not explaining himself beyond the fact.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 英国公爵家の継承制度を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You worked on British peerage succession systems for your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Engaged but with a slight edge of amusement. Asuka's tone has sharpened just a touch—she's testing now, curious about where this is going.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、敗者復活戦の心理学を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I actually researched the psychology of comeback and redemption.
lines.style: Ren's patience is steady but the corrections are adding up. His voice stays even, almost matter-of-fact. No exasperation, just persistence.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、前世療法の医学的検証を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you studied past-life regression therapy for your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Slower now. Asuka's tone has shifted—quieter, more thoughtful. She's pieced something together. The words land with a gentle weight.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、教育における難問の解法研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I wrote about solving difficult problems in educational contexts.
lines.style: Ren's final correction. Quieter, slightly worn. The accumulation is in his voice now, but he's still standing by it. A small, tired resolution.
